no-target.label: Shot-lining flow asks about firing with no target
no-target.explanation: The Borg carries a bow and arrows and knows a kobold it cannot shoot from here. A movement-flow probe asks whether a distance attack exists while the target list is empty and the simulation flag is off — the state the Teleport Other defense and any acted attack leave behind. The original still enters the firing path: it reads the description of missile slot -1 and queues a fire key, a quiver character computed from index -1, and the target key. The correction returns "nothing to fire" without queueing anything.

live-shot.label: Control: a real target fires normally
live-shot.explanation: With the target list filled the way the attack chooser fills it, both versions queue the real firing keys and value the shot above zero. The logs are identical before and after the fix.
